TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dense AI-generated collage with a cinematic orange-and-blue palette: a large portrait of Donald Trump in profile occupies the upper left against walls of glowing data monitors, while satellites orbit a curved, city-lit Earth and emit beams of light downward, with military transport planes flying in formation above a night skyline that includes Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament. Below, three armed tactical officers escort a handcuffed man in dark clothing toward vehicles; a black-gloved fist in the foreground holds a smartphone displaying a warning triangle and an emergency-alert screen, and the lower right is piled with banded stacks of US currency, gold bars, a laptop showing a glowing globe, and small devices. A soldier with a rifle stands at lower left near a transport aircraft on the ground.
TEXT: EBS, OVERT
SYMBOLS: numbers, clock, trump

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A vertical AI-generated allegory of stacked power rendered as six glowing circular tiers floating in dark space against a dim golden world map: the top tier holds a skyline of skyscrapers with three suited figures silhouetted before it; the second shows a massive circular bank-vault door surrounded by robed and suited people with money tables; the third is heaped with gold coins and oversized dollar bills; the fourth is a control room of analysts before a wall of blue monitors; the fifth is a boardroom of seated decision-makers; and the widest bottom tier is a dense crowd of ordinary people viewed from behind. A central vertical axis of light and concentric rings connects all tiers, suggesting hierarchy from unseen controllers down to the masses.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: pyramid, door

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Aerial view of a large futuristic hospital campus on a sunny day: a sprawling white multi-story complex with angular glass facades, a central rooftop helipad with a blue-and-white helicopter and a second helicopter on an adjacent pad, rooftop solar panels and terraced gardens, and giant three-dimensional block letters on the main facade reading MEDBED HOSPITAL. The grounds include curving access roads with two ambulances and a few cars, manicured lawns, flower beds and trees, with a lake, distant treeline and low horizon visible under a clear blue sky.
TEXT: MEDBED HOSPITAL
SYMBOLS: water

TYPE: document
SUBJECT: A scanned or photocopied typewritten birth certificate on ornate guilloche-bordered paper, titled as a Louisiana Certificate of Live Birth, with many personal fields blurred or redacted in gray smudges, checkboxes for sex and plurality (GIRL and Single marked), fields for hospital, parish (ST. TAMMANY), state, and parents, and registrar signature blocks at the bottom. A red annotation circle/box in the lower right contains the number 234322 with a long red arrow drawn up to the same number printed in red at the top-left corner of the document, highlighting the file number match.
TEXT: STATE OF LOUISIANA / THIS RECORD IS VALID FOR BIRTH ONLY / STATE OF LOUISIANA CERTIFICATE OF LIVE BIRTH / Birth No. 11... / 1974 / 5:21 P.M. / GIRL / Single / Twin / Triplet / MEMORIAL HOSPITAL / ST. TAMMANY / LOUISIANA / WHITE / CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION FOR MEDICAL AND HEALTH USE ONLY / 234322
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A dim, warm-lit indoor swimming pool photographed from the deck: three people are in the green-tinted water — in the left foreground a person with short dark wet hair reaches forward through the water, mid-frame another person sits submerged to the shoulders facing right, and at right a third person seen from behind has their head completely covered by a black redaction box. The pool edge has a Greek-key pattern mosaic tile border, and the background shows an opulent interior with carved wooden cabinetry, columns and a drinks bar area; low light reflects off the rippling water surface.
